error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. What you wrote is saved. Try again.
welcome.p1: You trained somewhere else. The place you live now has a way to recognize that.
welcome.p2: Earned reads the documents you already have, names the office that decides your case, and shows what that office has seen, what is still missing and the one thing to do next. In your language.
welcome.p3: It does not decide anything. The office decides. We tell you exactly where each decision stands.
welcome.depth: Mapped in full today for elementary teachers in California. For any other work or state, it still reads your documents, names the office and writes your first question to them.
opener.title: Tell me where you are.
opener.lead: In your own words, in any language. What you did before, where you studied, where you live now, what you have already tried.
opener.placeholder: For example, I taught primary school in Guadalajara for ten years and moved to San Jose. I got a letter from the state I don't understand.
opener.hint: Speak or type. Either is fine.
opener.ex_mariana: A primary teacher from Mexico with a letter from the CTC
opener.ex_mariana_text: Hi, I'm Mariana. I taught primary school, second to fifth grade, in Guadalajara, Mexico for ten years. I have my cédula profesional. I live in San Jose now. I applied to the CTC and they sent back a letter I don't really understand.
opener.ex_lin: A junior high teacher from China about to pay for an evaluation
opener.ex_lin_text: Hi, I'm Lin Wei. I taught junior high Chinese in Hangzhou, China for eight years. I live in Oakland. I have my diploma and my teacher certificate. I'm about to pay an agency to evaluate my degree but I don't know where to start.
opener.ex_nurse: A nurse from the Philippines in Texas
opener.ex_nurse_text: I worked as a nurse in Manila for six years and have my Philippine nursing license. I moved to Houston last year. I haven't started anything here.
opener.continue: Now show me what you have

office.found_by_search: Found on an official page today. Confirm on their site before you rely on it.
docs.reading: Reading. This takes a few seconds.

ask.ctc_letter.looks: A letter from the Commission, often titled Returned or Deficiency, with numbered items.
ask.ctc_letter.for: Each item they asked for, and the date, because a clock starts with it.
ask.evaluation_report.looks: A report from an evaluation agency with a US equivalency line and a report type.
ask.evaluation_report.for: The report type, because the CTC accepts only one kind, and the agency name.
ask.transcript.looks: The official list of your courses and grades from your school.
ask.transcript.for: Your program and the courses where you taught under supervision.
ask.degree.for: The degree name, the school and the date.
ask.license.looks: The license or certificate that let you work at home.
ask.license.for: Who issued it and for what. A photocopy is enough.
ask.experience.looks: A letter from your employer or education office about your years of work.
ask.experience.for: Your role, the school and the dates. It is yours even when it is not required.
label.degree.title: Degree
label.ctc_letter.subject: Subject
label.other.title: Document
position.header: {name}, here is what you already have.
position.header_noname: Here is what you already have.
position.later_note: Reading, the US Constitution, subject exams (CSET) and induction belong to the clear credential. You have five years after the preliminary to do them.
position.nothing_yet: I have not seen any document yet.
position.nothing_needed: This is what the CTC asks for. Upload what you have and we cross it off.
position.experience_note: Not required for the preliminary credential, but it is yours.
position.letter_items: What the CTC letter asks for
position.letter_paperwork: This one is paperwork, not coursework.
position.ctc_intro: The Commission on Teacher Credentialing, the CTC, decides your case.
position.near_note: We have mapped the elementary route in full. For secondary teaching (Single Subject, leaflet CL-870) the first steps are the same, and where a rule differs we say we can't tell yet.
req.R01.have: A course-by-course evaluation of your studies
req.R01.missing.report_type_general: A course-by-course evaluation from an agency the CTC approves. The one you have is general, and the CTC does not accept it for the credential.
req.R01.missing.report_type_other: A course-by-course evaluation. The report you uploaded does not say it is one.
req.R01.missing.agency_not_approved: A course-by-course evaluation from an agency on the CTC's list. The report you have comes from an agency that is not on it.
req.R01.unknown.q.have_evaluation: Whether you already have an evaluation of your studies. If you do, upload it. It changes everything that follows.
req.R02.have: The report comes from {agency}, which is on the CTC's approved list
req.R02.missing.agency_not_on_list: An evaluation from an agency on the CTC's list. {agency} is not on it. Ask the agency whether it is listed before paying again.
req.R02.missing.agency_closed: An evaluation from an agency on the CTC's list. {agency} closed before this report was dated.
req.R04.have: The report states an equivalence to a US degree. The CTC confirms it when it reviews.
req.R04.unknown.q.equivalence_decided_by: Whether the agency treats your school as equivalent to an accredited US one. The agency decides that when it writes the course-by-course report.
req.R04.unknown.q.upload_degree: Your degree. Upload your diploma or transcript and we read it.
req.R05.missing.evaluation_lists_no_cour: That the evaluation mentions your student teaching. It does not today, because the general report lists no courses. Your transcript does list {named}. What is missing is someone documenting it, not the student teaching itself.
req.R05.missing.evaluation_omits_practic: That the evaluation names your student teaching. This report lists courses but none as student teaching. Your transcript lists {named}.
req.R05.missing.report_from_unlisted_age: That an evaluation from an approved agency names your student teaching.
req.R05.unknown.q.practicum_evidence: Whether your program included supervised student teaching. Your transcript has no course with a name the CTC or an agency would recognize as a practicum. That does not mean there was none. The CTC decides, and the question is already written.
req.R05.unknown.q.upload_transcript: Your student teaching. Upload your transcript and we look for it.
req.R06.have: Your teaching license from home. The CTC decides whether it is comparable.
req.R06.missing.no_foreign_license: A teaching license from the country where you trained. The CTC accepts one you were eligible for, even if it is not valid now.
req.R06.unknown.q.upload_license: Your teaching license from home. A photo or photocopy is enough for the CTC.
req.R07.have: The agency saw your teaching license
req.R07.missing.license_not_sent_to_agen: That the agency also sees your teaching license. The report you have does not list it among what it reviewed.
req.R07.missing.report_from_unlisted_age: That an approved agency reviews your teaching license with the rest.
req.R08.have: Original documents for the agency, according to you
req.R09.missing.live_scan: Fingerprints by Live Scan in California.
req.R09.missing.fd258_cards: Fingerprints on two FD-258 cards ordered from the CTC, $49, because you live outside California.
req.R11.have: A Social Security number or an ITIN, according to you
req.R11.missing.no_ssn_or_itin: A Social Security number or an ITIN. California law requires one to issue the credential, and no step we can offer resolves it.
req.R12.have: Preparation for elementary teaching ({program}). The CTC decides when it reviews.
req.R13.have: An overall C average or better, as converted by the evaluator
req.R21.missing.respond_by: Answer the CTC letter by {deadline}, with a copy of the letter. {days} days left.
why.title: Why
why.saw: What we saw in your documents
why.saw_none: Nothing yet. Upload a document and it shows here.
why.discretion: There is room for judgment on this point.
why.no_discretion: There is no room for interpretation on this point.
why.live_found: The CTC page says exactly this today, {when}.
why.live_not_found: The page changed since we read it. A person has to review this rule before you rely on it.
why.live_failed: We could not open the CTC page right now. The quote is from {date}.
route.title: Preliminary Multiple Subject credential, direct application to the CTC
route.decides: Who decides · The Commission on Teacher Credentialing, the CTC
route.step.evaluation: Request a course-by-course evaluation from an approved agency, sending your teaching license too
route.step.practicum: Make your student teaching visible, on the transcript or in a letter from your school
route.step.respond_letter: Answer the CTC letter within the deadline, with the letter attached
route.step.fd258: FD-258 fingerprint cards, ordered from the CTC
cost.paid: Already paid. If you answer the letter in time you do not pay it again.
cost.evaluation: Course-by-course evaluation. The agency sets its price. Check their page before paying.
cost.live_scan: Live Scan. The location that takes your fingerprints charges it.
route.timing: Online applications are typically processed within 50 business days, unless there is a fitness review.
route.bridge: The CTC accepts a general report only for this permit. Your current report could let you work as a substitute while the course-by-course report is prepared. A school has to want to hire you and it has its own requirements. Confirm with the CTC before relying on it.
route.blocker: There is a requirement no step we can offer resolves.
week.title: This week
week.request_evaluation: Request the course-by-course report from an approved agency
week.request_evaluation.why: It is the one step that answers both items of the CTC letter.
week.request_evaluation.why_noletter: Every other step on the route depends on this report.
week.request_school_letter: Ask your school for a letter about your student teaching
week.request_school_letter.why: Your transcript lists {named}, but nothing says how many hours or where. A letter from the school makes it visible to the agency.
week.request_school_letter.deferred: The course-by-course report is still required and nobody can skip it. It can wait until you can pay for it. The school letter costs nothing and the agency will need it.
week.respond_ctc_letter: Send your answer to the CTC letter
week.respond_ctc_letter.why: You have what the letter asked for. Send it with a copy of the letter before the deadline.
week.live_scan: Get your fingerprints taken by Live Scan
week.live_scan.why: The CTC needs fingerprint clearance before it issues the credential.
week.ask_ctc_question: Ask the CTC how to document your student teaching
week.ask_ctc_question.why: Before you pay for anything, the CTC can tell you what it needs from your school. The question is written.
week.confirm_resubmit: Ask the CTC whether you need to apply again
week.confirm_resubmit.why: The letter's deadline passed on {deadline}. Most likely the application has to be submitted again with the $100 fee. Confirm with the CTC before doing anything.
week.apply_ctc.why: The CTC starts its review when the application and fee arrive.
week.upload_evaluation: Did you already pay for an evaluation of your studies? If so, upload it. It changes everything that follows.
week.wait: Now it is the CTC's turn
week.wait.why: It usually takes up to 50 business days. There is nothing else to send meanwhile.
week.deadline: The letter gives you 60 days from {letter}. {days} days left. If it passes, the CTC keeps the fee and you apply again.
week.cost.evaluation: The agency sets its price. The CTC application is already paid.
week.after.request_evaluation: The agency sends you the report. Upload it here, we read it together and prepare the answer to the letter.
week.after.request_school_letter: The school sends the letter to the agency. Record it in Progress when it is sent.
week.after.ask_ctc_question: The CTC answers by email. Upload or note the answer here and the route updates.
week.after.respond_ctc_letter: The CTC reviews. It usually takes up to 50 business days.
week.after.generic: Record it in Progress when it is done and the route updates.
week.before_paying.text: Choose course-by-course (detailed), not document-by-document. Send your teaching license with the other documents.
week.before_paying.ierf: If the agency is IERF, the CTC says to check, in Section 2, Professional Licensing/Certification, Field Teaching, State CA.
week.also: Also this week, if there is time
week.see_question: See the question for the CTC
week.agency_list: See the list of approved agencies
week.packet.letter: A copy of the CTC letter of {date}
week.ssn.q: The CTC asks for a Social Security number or an ITIN to issue the credential. Do you have one of the two?
letter.fill: Fill in what is in square brackets before sending.
letter.nothing_sent: Nothing is sent from here. You send it.
letter.aid_same: The same, in English, for you
letter.aid_other: In the school's language, in case they ask for it
letter.failed: I could not prepare the letter. Here is the empty template to fill in.
letter.to_ctc: To · Questions Regarding Applications, Contact the Commission page
progress.title: Progress
progress.to.submitted: I submitted it to the CTC
progress.ctc_note: The CTC still has to review. Only a CTC notice marks something accepted.
progress.empty: Nothing to track yet. The first action appears here once you see where you stand.
change.title: Change my circumstances
change.lead: Change one thing and see what moves. Nothing here changes your case unless you say it happened.
change.report: I already have an evaluation report
change.budget: This is what I can spend right now
change.budget.can_pay_evaluation: I can pay for the evaluation
change.school: My school can send a letter about my practicum
change.school.no: No, the school can't or won't
change.letter: The CTC letter was mailed on
change.summary.none: Nothing in your route changes. The CTC's requirements are the same across California. Only where your fingerprints would be taken changes.
change.summary.n: {n} of the requirements move. Everything else stays, because the CTC's rules do not change, only the evidence or your situation.
change.summary.next_only: No requirement moves. What changes is the order of what you do this week.
change.needs_upload.report: For this to count, upload the new report and we read it.
change.needs_upload.letter_date: To change the letter date, correct it in Documents next to the letter.
change.needs_upload.none: The general report is already uploaded. You can replace it in Documents.
change.bridge_disappears: The 30-day substitute permit no longer applies.
change.blocker_appears: A requirement appears that no step we can offer resolves.
change.fingerprint_method: Fingerprints change from Live Scan to FD-258 cards, $49.
change.fingerprint_location: Only the place where your fingerprints would be taken changes.
action.request_school_letter: Student teaching letter from your school
action.confirm_resubmit: Confirm with the CTC whether to apply again
general.title: What we can do today
general.documents: Upload what you have. I read each document and tell you exactly what it says.
req.R02.unknown.q.have_evaluation: Which agency writes your evaluation. It has to be one on the CTC's approved list.
wa.send_photo: Send a photo or a PDF of it here.
wa.link: Your case on the web, to read it calmly · {url}
wa.voice_declined: I can't listen to voice notes yet. Write me the answer and I'll read it.
wa.unsupported: I can't read that. Send me a photo or a PDF of the document.
wa.fix: If something is wrong, open the web link and fix it there.
wa.why_web: Each line opens to the CTC sentence behind it on the web · {url}
